title: Clay-cation Membership
source_quote: Access to various firings including: Electric Oxidation Firing, Gas Reduction Firing, Gas Soda Firing, Gas Raku Firing and Pit Firing
evidence_sentence: Clay-cation membership includes access to multiple firing types: electric oxidation, gas reduction, soda, raku, and pit firing.
evidence_quote: Access to various firings including: Electric Oxidation Firing, Gas Reduction Firing, Gas Soda Firing, Gas Raku Firing and Pit Firing
summary: This short-term membership ($125/week plus tax) gives visiting potters 24-hour studio access and includes raku, pit, soda, and gas reduction firings. Application is open to experienced artists 18+; contact the studio to apply.
cost_text: $125 a week plus 7% WV Sales Tax
pay_text: $125 a week plus 7% WV Sales Tax
